title: The Burnt Cover
author: A. M. Dunmore
blurb: Lena Hartwell, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the summit convenes.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
